For sky130 that includes the MIM capacitors (reported `null`, i.e. unverified rather than off), so capacitor mismatch remains a separate owed mechanism (design/integrator/SIZING.md -> "Not simulated (owed)") and this record must not be read as an all-mechanisms number.

sqrt_wl_prediction.note: The sqrt(W L) argument in design/integrator/SIZING.md predicts the differential residual grows as sqrt of the channel-area ratio. `summing_node_switches` is the prediction that applies to the output: only Sti/Str inject into the summing node, and Sbi/Sbr turn-off charge lands on the bottom plate, which the next phi1 re-drives from vinp/rsel before any transfer. `all_phi2_vcm_switches` is SIZING.md's own framing, kept for comparison. Areas are read from the simulated netlists; `nfet_01v8` -> `nfet_01v8_lvt` is part of the #92 delta and changes the charge at equal area, so neither factor is a complete prediction.

derived.verdict_inputs: Read `sigma_ratio_ota_removed` (with its standard error) against `sqrt_area_ratio` for `summing_node_switches` -- the pair that injects into the summing node -- and against `all_phi2_vcm_switches`, which is design/integrator/SIZING.md's own framing. Use the OTA-removed ratio, not the raw one: the raw per-clock differential step under mismatch is dominated by the OTA's own input offset, and sqrt(W L) is a claim about the switches. The #92 delta also swaps nfet_01v8 for nfet_01v8_lvt on those switches, which neither sqrt(W L) factor accounts for.
derived.estimator: sigma is the sample standard deviation (statistics.stdev, n-1) of dvod_mean over the Monte Carlo samples at each anchor point. sigma_dvod_ota_removed_V is the residual standard deviation (n-2 dof) after least-squares regressing dvod_mean on the same sample's measured OTA offset `vod_rst`; it is reported only where |r| >= 0.95, and the slope and r are always reported so the separation can be judged. No distribution is assumed beyond quoting the usual 1/sqrt(2*dof) relative standard error.
